## Customer Quotation Delivery

- **Delivers an already-approved quotation** created and approved by the quotation-owning business application. This workflow does not create quotations, does not calculate prices/tax/totals, and does not generate a PDF or any legally authoritative quotation document.
- **recipientPhone, quotation number, amount, currency, valid-until date, and link token are NOT caller inputs.** All read exclusively from Postgres (`quotations`) -- arbitrary caller data can never redirect or fabricate a quotation delivery.
- **The quotation link is never a caller- or database-supplied full URL.** It is always `<fixed hardcoded HTTPS origin>` + an opaque, strictly-validated token read from Postgres -- there is no host/scheme/userinfo for a caller or a compromised database row to redirect.
- **Idempotency reservation and the eligibility decision happen in ONE atomic PL/pgSQL function** (`process_quotation_delivery`), and finalize verifies exact idempotency-key ownership before mutating anything -- modeled on the corrected, adversarially-tested pattern in `unpaid-invoice-reminder`.
- **Only genuinely approved, non-expired, not-already-delivered quotations reach the sender.**
- **No automatic retries anywhere in this workflow.**
